name: Computer Programming Lab
description: Hands-on programming course covering data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns in Java.

name: Analysis & Design of Algorithms
description: Theoretical and practical study of algorithm design paradigms: divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, greedy, and graph algorithms.

name: Microprocessors & Computer Architecture
description: Architecture of modern microprocessors, memory hierarchy, pipelining, and assembly language programming.

name: Media Technology Studio
description: Practical studio course covering digital media production, interactive design, and multimedia systems.

name: Human-Computer Interaction
description: Principles and practice of user-centered design, usability evaluation, and interactive system development.

name: Database I
description: Relational model, SQL, entity-relationship diagrams, normalisation, and transaction management.

name: Systems & Networks Programming
description: Socket programming, concurrent processes, OS system calls, and network protocol implementation in C.

name: Software Engineering
description: Agile and waterfall methodologies, requirements engineering, UML modelling, and quality assurance practices.
